content.title: Banco Macro: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: BUENOS AIRES, Argentina (AP) — Banco Macro SA (BMA) on Wednesday reported a loss of $24.9 million in its third quarter. The bank, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, said it had a loss of 39 cents per share. The financial holding company posted revenue of $1.05 billion in the period.
